philosophy.title: Our Educational Philosophy & Standards
philosophy.intro: International medical education extends beyond the development of knowledge and language skills. It is a structured process of cultivating clinical communication, global medical perspective, and professional values.

items.title: Learner-centred Approach
items.desc: We place learners at the heart of the educational experience, with strong emphasis on interaction, engagement, and practical application. Learners are encouraged to actively participate, express themselves, and build professional confidence through real communication practice and feedback.

items.title: Real-world Clinical Relevance
items.desc: Our programmes are designed around authentic clinical environments and real-life medical cases. We prioritise practical application, ensuring that knowledge and skills are directly transferable to clinical practice.

items.title: Integration of International Standards
items.desc: We integrate international standards of medical communication, cross-cultural understanding, and global healthcare practice to develop communication skills aligned with the demands of international medical environments.

items.title: High-quality, Standardised Delivery
items.desc: We ensure consistency and excellence in learning outcomes through a structured, professional, and scalable teaching framework, delivering a high-quality and reliable learning experience across all programmes.

pillarsSection.title: Covering All Core Needs for International Development
pillarsSection.desc: Each pillar is jointly designed by senior education experts from China and the UK, progressing from foundational skills to advanced practice.

observership.title: Clinical Observership & International Exposure
observership.description: Connecting clinicians with the world's leading medical institutions to support international career growth. Built around three pillars — international clinical capability, research exchange and professional development — we deliver an end-to-end international exchange pathway covering clinical observership, research training, short-term overseas study, degree progression and doctoral programmes. Drawing on partnerships across the UK, US, Japan, Singapore and Germany, we provide one-stop support — from programme application and pre-departure preparation through to overseas assistance and reintegration on return — for healthcare institutions and individual professionals.

items.title: Professional team support throughout

items.title: Long-term collaboration within the international medical ecosystem
items.desc: We focus on more than a single exchange — building long-term international collaboration networks and global medical exchange capability for our partner institutions.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Mediversity Global — A global platform connecting medical education and cross-border healthcare services

story.title: Who We Are
story.paragraph1: Mediversity Global is dedicated to connecting healthcare professionals, international medical education, and high-quality global healthcare resources. With two core divisions — International Medical Education and Cross-border Medical Navigation — we promote international medical exchange, professional development, and cross-border healthcare collaboration.
story.paragraph2: Through a practice-led medical education approach and a professionally structured global healthcare network, we support healthcare professionals and institutions in systematically enhancing their international medical communication skills, global clinical perspective, and cross-cultural collaboration capabilities, enabling sustained professional growth within global healthcare environments.
story.paragraph3: At the same time, we provide end-to-end cross-border healthcare service support, spanning from medical decision-making to real-world care delivery. This includes connecting healthcare needs with appropriate global medical resources and ensuring effective execution across the full care pathway, while enabling more efficient, safer, and more reliable international healthcare connectivity and collaboration.

whoWeServe.title: Who We Serve
whoWeServe.intro: Mediversity Global serves a diverse range of stakeholders within the global healthcare ecosystem, including healthcare professionals, healthcare institutions, and individuals requiring cross-border medical support. We provide tailored support across different user groups: enabling healthcare professionals to enhance their international communication skills and career development, supporting institutions in strengthening global capability and cross-cultural collaboration, and assisting patients and families in accessing reliable cross-border healthcare pathways and resources.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Mediversity Global is committed to protecting your personal information and privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect your information when you access and use our website, and the rights you have in relation to your information.
privacy.disclaimer: This privacy policy is an interim template version. The final version will be the formal document authorised by our legal team. In case of any conflict, the formal version shall prevail.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect only the minimum information necessary to provide our services. This includes:
· Information you actively provide — name, email address, phone number, organisation, and the content of any enquiry you submit via our contact form or consultation request;
· Information collected automatically — access logs (IP address, access time, browser type, operating system, referring page) and cookie identifiers;
· Communication records — emails, messages and call records generated through your interaction with us.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We use your information for the following purposes:
· To respond to your enquiry and provide the services you have requested;
· To assess your needs and recommend appropriate medical education or healthcare navigation pathways;
· To improve website functionality and user experience;
· With your explicit consent, to send you service updates or industry insights;
· To comply with applicable laws, regulations and regulatory requirements.
We do not use your personal information for any other purpose not stated in this policy.

sections.heading: Cookies and Similar Technologies
paragraphs: This website uses essential cookies to maintain basic functionality (such as language preferences and session state). We may also use analytics cookies to understand how users interact with our website, with all analytics data being anonymised.
You may refuse or delete cookies at any time through your browser settings. Please note that some features may not function properly as a result.

sections.heading: Sharing and Disclosure
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information with third parties only in the following circumstances:
· With your explicit authorisation, to provide necessary information to healthcare institutions, education partners or service contacts you have selected, in order to facilitate the service;

· With trusted service providers who assist in operating our website (such as cloud hosting, email services, analytics), limited to the minimum information necessary for them to perform the entrusted task;
· Where required by law, regulation, regulatory authority or legal process.

sections.heading: Cross-border Data Transfers
paragraphs: Mediversity Global operates as a bi-directional service platform between China and overseas markets, and our services inherently involve cross-border data transfers. Our infrastructure is distributed between China (Tencent Cloud, Shanghai) and the UK (AWS, London), and your information may be transferred and stored between these locations.
We apply industry-standard transmission encryption (TLS) and access control to ensure data security during cross-border transfers.

sections.heading: Data Storage and Security
paragraphs: We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your personal information, including but not limited to transmission encryption (HTTPS), access control and audit logging.

Enquiry information is typically retained for up to two years after service completion; automatically collected access logs are retained for six months. Where applicable laws require otherwise, those requirements apply.

sections.heading: Your Rights
paragraphs: Subject to the applicable laws of your jurisdiction (including China's Personal Information Protection Law, UK GDPR and EU GDPR), you have the following rights in relation to your personal information:
· Right to access and obtain a copy of your personal information;
· Right to rectify inaccurate or incomplete information;
· Right to delete your personal information (where permitted by law);
· Right to withdraw previously given consent;
· Right to restrict or object to specific processing;
· Right to data portability (where technically feasible).
To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the details at the bottom of this page.

sections.heading: Children's Information
paragraphs: This website is not intended for children under the age of 14. If you are under 14, please do not submit any personal information through this website. If we become aware that we have inadvertently collected information from a child, we will delete it promptly.

sections.heading: Policy Updates
paragraphs: We may update this privacy policy from time to time in response to changes in law, regulation or our business. Significant changes will be notified through a website announcement. Continued use of the website following such updates constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.heading: Governing Law
paragraphs: This privacy policy is governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China. For users from the UK and EU, we additionally comply with the relevant provisions of the UK GDPR and EU GDPR.

· International medical education programmes — covering medical English, clinical observership, research and academic development, and medical humanities;
· Cross-border medical navigation — coordinating medical resources, consolidating information, and supporting processes for users navigating international healthcare.
Information provided on this website is for general reference only and does not constitute medical advice, diagnosis or treatment recommendations.

All medical diagnoses, treatment decisions and clinical actions are made independently by the regulated healthcare institutions and licensed clinicians of your choice, who are directly responsible to you.

Resource recommendations, pathway suggestions and process support we provide are for your reference only. You are responsible for verifying relevant information and making independent healthcare decisions.
